keyEvents.text: First Half begins.
Delay in match (Tigres).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Edwin Cerrillo (Club América) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Delay in match because of an injury Franco Rossano (Club América).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
César Araújo (Tigres) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
First Half ends, Tigres 0, Club América 0.
Substitution, Tigres. Edgar Villavicencio replaces César Araújo.
Substitution, Tigres. Ozziel Herrera replaces Isac Galván.
Second Half begins Tigres 0, Club América 0.
Substitution, Club América. Miguel Borja replaces Henry Martín.
Substitution, Club América. Isaías Violante replaces Carlos Álvarez.
Substitution, Club América. Israel Reyes replaces Edwin Cerrillo.
Substitution, Tigres. Jesús Garza replaces Vladimir Loroña.
Franco Rossano (Club América) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Club América. Cristián Borja replaces Franco Rossano.
Substitution, Tigres. Rodrigo Aguirre replaces Diego Lainez.
Substitution, Club América. Derek Jiménez replaces Óscar Perea.
Alan Cervantes (Club América) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Tigres. Juan Vigón replaces Rômulo.
Israel Reyes (Club América) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Tigres 1, Club América 0. Juan Brunetta (Tigres) from a free kick with a right footed shot to the top left corner.
Juan Brunetta (Tigres) is shown the yellow card for excessive celebration.
Second Half ends, Tigres 1, Club América 0.
